messages:
sam-t: Heads-up — got alerts for a weird OIDC loop after the RBAC enforcement: token introspection returning 401s, SCIM shows repeated provision+deprov churn for some tenants.

iris-l: Same here. Service logs show jwt introspect failing with `invalid_aud` and JWKS fetch 404/timeout spikes. Example:
```
ERROR auth-introspect: introspect failed tenant=nova err=401 reason=invalid_aud aud=api://v2
WARN jwks-fetcher: fetch jwks tenant=beta url=https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json status=504
```

mohan-r: Quick hypothesis: two interacting issues: (1) IdP rotated signing keys and updated JWKS URL TTL, (2) RBAC rollout tightened audience validation (now requires aud=api://redwood) so older tokens with previous aud fail. The combination causes introspect to reject tokens -> downstream SCIM workers assume creds invalid and schedule deprov->reprovision churn.

isis-l: Also noticed audit-shipper reported rate-limited writes during the same window so some role-change events might not have been recorded. audit-bot shows a small gap.

sam-t: Quick checks to run:
```
curl -I https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json
kubectl logs -n infra deploy/auth-introspect --since=2h | grep invalid_aud | head -n 5
redis-cli HGET token:introspect:tenant:beta last_jwks_etag
```

mohan-r: I pulled the tenant config for nova — their tokens still present aud=api://v2 (legacy). Our new aud check rejects them. We can temporarily relax the strict aud check to accept both api://v2 and api://redwood for tenant-gated fallbacks.

iris-l: For JWKS hiccups, add short-circuit cache TTL increases and retry jitter in fetcher; meanwhile, we can prime jwks cache from IdP and warm introspecters.

oncall: Opening incident INC-182500. Mitigations I'm running:
```
# enable tenant fallback aud list
kubectl set env deploy/auth-introspect SAML_ACCEPT_AUD="api://v2,api://redwood" -n infra
# prime jwks
kubectl exec -n infra deploy/jwks-fetcher -- /usr/local/bin/prime-jwks --tenant beta --url https://idp.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json
./scripts/requeue-scim-provision.sh --tenant nova --since 1824999000
```

audit-bot: audit shipper shows restart during rotation; 17 audit events buffered and not flushed at 1824999800. Backfill scheduled.

mohan-r: Owners: Mohan=aud fallback + config PR to make aud set tenant-scoped, Iris=JWKS cache hardening + prime, Sam=SCIM requeue & verify, Oncall=customer comms and incident timeline. We should also add a preflight check for aud claim compatibility before RBAC enforcement.

sam-t: Will validate reprovision churn stops after aud fallback and jwks prime; will post logs here. If stable for 30m we close and schedule postmortem. :thumbsup:
